{"project_id": "essesdjgtmralbkglpzw", "name": "send-booking-confirmation", "entrypoint_path": "functions/send-booking-confirmation/index.ts", "verify_jwt": true, "files": [{"name": "functions/send-booking-confirmation/index.ts", "content": "// Deploy bootstrap: gunzip bundled source, rewrite relative imports, dynamic-import.\nconst B64 = \"\";\n\nfunction b64ToBytes(b64: string): Uint8Array {\n  const bin = atob(b64);\n  const out = new Uint8Array(bin.length);\n  for (let i = 0; i < bin.length; i++) out[i] = bin.charCodeAt(i);\n  return out;\n}\n\nasync function gunzip(bytes: Uint8Array): Promise<string> {\n  const ds = new DecompressionStream(\"gzip\");\n  const stream = new Blob([bytes]).stream().pipeThrough(ds);\n  const ab = await new Response(stream).arrayBuffer();\n  return new TextDecoder().decode(ab);\n}\n\nlet source = await gunzip(b64ToBytes(B64));\nsource = source.replace(\n  /from\\s+([\\\"'])(\\.\\.?\\/[^\\\"']+)\\1/g,\n  (_m, _q, rel) => `from \"${new URL(rel, import.meta.url).href}\"`,\n);\nawait import(\"data:application/typescript;charset=utf-8,\" + encodeURIComponent(source));\n"}, {"name": "functions/send-booking-confirmation/cors.ts", "content": "export { getCorsHeaders } from '../_shared/cors.ts';\n"}, {"name": "functions/_shared/cors.ts", "content": "const ALLOWED_HEADERS = 'authorization, x-client-info, apikey, content-type';\nconst ALLOWED_METHODS = 'GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, OPTIONS';\n\nfunction parseAllowedOrigins(): Set<string> {\n  const raw = Deno.env.get('ALLOWED_ORIGINS') ?? '';\n  return new Set(\n    raw\n      .split(',')\n      .map((origin) => origin.trim())\n      .filter(Boolean),\n  );\n}\n\nlet cachedOrigins: Set<string> | null = null;\n\nfunction getAllowedOrigins(): Set<string> {\n  if (!cachedOrigins) {\n    cachedOrigins = parseAllowedOrigins();\n  }\n  return cachedOrigins;\n}\n\n/** Origin-aware CORS headers. Set ALLOWED_ORIGINS (comma-separated) in env. */\nexport function getCorsHeaders(req: Request): Record<string, string> {\n  const headers: Record<string, string> = {\n    'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': ALLOWED_HEADERS,\n    'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': ALLOWED_METHODS,\n  };\n\n  const origin = req.headers.get('Origin');\n  if (origin && getAllowedOrigins().has(origin)) {\n    headers['Access-Control-Allow-Origin'] = origin;\n    headers['Vary'] = 'Origin';\n  }\n\n  return headers;\n}\n"}, {"name": "functions/_shared/resolveBookingGrandTotal.ts", "content": "export function resolveBookingGrandTotal(booking: {\n  total_price?: number | null;\n  subtotal_before_tax?: number | null;\n  tax_amount?: number | null;\n}): number {\n  const subtotal = Number(booking.subtotal_before_tax ?? 0);\n  const tax = Number(booking.tax_amount ?? 0);\n  const stored = Number(booking.total_price ?? 0);\n  const computed = Math.round((subtotal + tax) * 100) / 100;\n\n  if (subtotal > 0 && tax > 0 && Math.abs(stored - subtotal) < 0.02) {\n    return computed;\n  }\n\n  return stored > 0 ? stored : computed;\n}\n"}, {"name": "functions/_shared/formatBookingTime.ts", "content": "/**\n * Parse booking time slots stored as 24h (HH:mm / HH:mm:ss) or 12h (h:mm a).\n */\nexport function parseBookingTimeToDate(timeString: string): Date | null {\n  if (!timeString || typeof timeString !== \"string\") return null;\n  const trimmed = timeString.trim();\n  if (!trimmed) return null;\n\n  const ref = new Date(2000, 0, 1);\n\n  const try24WithSeconds = /^(\\d{1,2}):(\\d{2}):(\\d{2})$/.exec(trimmed);\n  if (try24WithSeconds) {\n    const d = new Date(ref);\n    d.setHours(parseInt(try24WithSeconds[1], 10), parseInt(try24WithSeconds[2], 10), 0, 0);\n    return d;\n  }\n\n  const try24 = /^
